name: Icebane Gauntlets
label: Quest
description: Icebane Gauntlets: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Icebane gauntlets. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is your order, friend. Delivered as promised!
